correctness.rationale: The replicator advantage is B Σp_n(1−x)^(n−1)−C, with a unique interior stable root for n>=2 and 0<C<B. For four sizes, difference of moment-matched laws lies in the nullspace of the 3×4 Vandermonde and equals Δm3 times signed barycentric weights. The third divided difference of q^(t−1) is (log q)^3 q^(ξ−1)/6<0 on 0<q<1, establishing ALL q and costs; at <=3 nodes full rank gives uniqueness. Independently verified exact signed tests for all 210 four-support subsets of {2,...,11} at three rational q each (630 tests), and both 4/5-size examples. Five-size U,V have moments (1,4,18,88) and G_U−G_V=q(1−q)^4/20. These finite cases are checks, not the unbounded proof.
